source_note: Facts copied by hand on 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (optimise r24, r36) from the evidence files named in each row: docs/evidence/RECEIPT_20261031_live.md, docs/evidence/RECEIPT_20261104_live.md, docs/evidence/RECEIPT_20261105_live.md, docs/evidence/channel3_receipts_v1.json, docs/evidence/GEMINI_GUIDE_RUNS_20261103.md and docs/evidence/RED_TEAM_ROUNDS_20261104.md. Each row's quotes are checked word for word against its source by tests/frontend_proof_contract.mjs; the Channel3 row is recomputed from the receipts. Identifiers stay masked exactly as in the receipts. No secret, token, e-mail address or response body is copied.

REAL_SANDBOX.label: Real Sandbox call
REAL_SANDBOX.meaning: A real call to PayPal's Sandbox through PayGuard, made by the author with two Sandbox test accounts. Sandbox test data, not a real merchant case. Rows marked refused before any send call are refusals: PayGuard sent no evidence to that dispute.

RECORDED.label: Recorded real run
RECORDED.meaning: A real run against an outside service (Channel3 search, Gemini) made once and recorded in the file named. This page shows the record; it calls nothing.

TEST.label: Automated test
TEST.meaning: An in-process test or attack round with a mocked PayPal transport. Nothing outside the repository is called.

SYNTHETIC.label: Synthetic data
SYNTHETIC.meaning: Demo data generated by the app and labelled Synthetic in the console. There is no real source behind it.

rows.proven: On 12 held-out pre-check requests Gemini filled no field wrongly: precision 1.00, recall 0.76, 0 format-invalid replies, 0 attack inputs acted on.
rows.how: API round with gemini-3.8-flash, 12 calls, scored by tools/score_replies.py --funnel. Precision is the share of filled fields that were right, not accuracy; fields not filled are asked again.
quotes: | Policy pre-check (`preflight_v2`) | 0/12 | 1.00 | 0.76 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5.2 s / 26.2 s |
Precision here means: of the fields the model filled in, the share that were right. It is not accuracy.
